name: CUnitServer::AdvanceAnimQueue

name: CUnitServer::PlayCurrentAnim

name: CUnitServer::SetAnimQueue

name: CUnitServer::CurrentAnimIsHitReaction
purpose: true while the current anim entry is a hit reaction (record key bits 0x3c0000 == 0x200000) and now < +0x38 + record +0x20

name: CUnitServer::TickAnimation

name: CUnitServer::SetState
purpose: (state -> +0x164): 5 (action) sets the timeout +0x180 = now + 10; others UpdateMoveParams and drop the hit effect +0x17c

name: CUnitServer::RestartIdleAnim
purpose: plays the pending hit reaction +0x160 (BuildHitDeathAnimQueue(+0x160, 0, 0)) unless an attack order in state 2 would miss its next-attack tick +0x184: saves the current queue to +0x148/+0x15c, +0x144 = 1, plays it, +0x21 = 1 (time frozen for the reaction)

name: CUnitServer::StopMove
purpose: 0x5B23A0(move state +0x3c) reset; 0x5C7B00(move state, owner pos, facing vector from the quat +0x34, world time) (settle) -> 0x52E9D0(owner); when owner+0x278 (0x9e) was set: re-register in the grid +0x294 with +0x278 = 0 and MarkNetDirty(7)

name: CUnitServer::ApplyMoveAnimSet
purpose: unless the state (+0x164) is 0 / 1 / 2: rebuilds the move anim set +0x960 when the key +0x95c (attack kind mask | move mode flag) changes (sneaking: anim 0xfe via 0x544D50, else the idle record 0x5301B0(owner, key | 0x80580000, 1)+0x10); copies it into the queue +0x24, +0x38 = +0x974 (or world time), AdvanceAnimQueue, plays the first entry

name: CUnitServer::ApplyMoveAnimSet2
purpose: (no callers): CUnit::RebuildMoveCurve(owner) first, then the body of ApplyMoveAnimSet 0x5474B0: unless state +0x164 is 0 / 1 / 2 the key = attack kind bit (weapon in slot +0x26c: CItemWeapon::GetDamageKind, else stats naturalAttackKind) | stance flag (0 crawl 0x30000, 1 sneak 0x20000, 2 walk in combatMode or non-0x32 kind 0x10000, 4 sit 0x8000) is compared with moveAnimKey +0x95c; changed: moveAnimSet +0x960 rebuilt (anim 0xfe for plain walking, else FindAnimRecord(key | MoveModeAnimFlag | 0x80580000)), +0x974 = -1, the set copied into the queue +0x24, AdvanceAnimQueue, SetAnim of the first entry. Dead copy kept by the linker

name: CUnitServer::TickMovement
purpose: per tick for states 0 (walking a path) and 1 (turning): Predict the curve at the world tick, test the entered cell (CanUnitMoveTo, FindOverlappingUnit: standing blocker = re-path, walking blocker = wait unless faster, follow-chain deadlock breaking), CollisionMap::MoveUnit + yaw, chunk end -> ContinueMove / arrival (Reset, SetStand, state 6); +0x278 = walking flag selects which stamp map the unit writes

name: AnimQueue_Assign
purpose: (this, src): CArray<12-byte entries> assign (0x558AB0 element init; grow step +0x10) + +0x14 = src+0x14 (12 callers)

name: CUnitServer::UpdateStance
purpose: applies the run flag: crippled/overloaded (EffectLevel) cancels running with message 0x14 / 0x15; running (+0x16D) is entered when wanted (+0x175), stance 2 (standing), on walkable ground and (no player, or the player's byte +0x108 set, or the specific's float +0x34 > 0: the stamina-like pool that running drains) and left after 6 ticks (+0x178) of failing; owner +0x264 = 3 while running (net 6); UpdateMoveParams; +0x146 = 1 (re-plan the path)

name: CUnitServer::BeginMoveTo
purpose: (goal[3], maxLength = goal z): UpdateStance, CMover::Reset, CUnit +0x43C kept, CAIMap::FindPath into the move state, +0xA4 = maxLength, ResetMover, state 0; failure: StopMove, state 6, +0x145 = partial flag

name: CUnitServer::StartTurnTo
purpose: (dir[3], speed): CMover::ResetAndTurnTo (request kind 1), ResetMover, move anim set, state = 1 (turning); not a path move

name: CUnitServer::PlayOneShotAnim
purpose: (anim queue by value): state 3; the queue becomes the current animation (+0x38 = its start or now), first entry played; move state settled facing forward (SetRect), owner +0x278 = 0 (net 7). Used for stance transitions, script animations (kind 7), death and the action recovery. Was StartAttacking

name: CUnitServer::PlayLoopAnim
purpose: same as PlayOneShotAnim with state 4 (looping script animation, order kind 8). Was StartCasting

name: CUnitServer::TickAction
purpose: state 5 tick of the action record +0xc4: at +0x180 (timeout) UpdateMoveParams; at +0xdc (strike start) the record's anim queue becomes the current animation (+0x38 = +0xd8) and a hit effect (CEffect kind 0x4a, id by +0xf8 damage kind) is attached when +0xec and proto+0x114; before +0xe0 (end tick): Mover::Predict drives position/facing toward the target (+0x278 walking flag, net 7); at +0xe0: CompleteOrder(+0xf0 hit location) -> the hit/cast/interaction happens, record reset (+0xe8 = 1e38, +0xf8 = 8), state 5 -> 3, mover settled (SetRect), SetSide(0)

name: CUnitServer::StartAction
purpose: (keepFacing, miss): stamps the miss flag into byte +2 of the action anim entries +0xc8; from states 3..6 refreshes the idle anim set (moveAnimKey) and plays it; state = 5, +0x180 = now + 10; move state: turn toward the target id +0xe4 (CMover::ResetWithTarget2, until +0xe0 / strike +0xdc) or toward the point +0xfc (ResetWithTarget3); ResetMover; owner +0x278 = 0 with grid re-registration (net 7). Was misnamed Die / StartAttackAnim2

name: CUnitServer::CancelAction
purpose: (force): aborts the action record +0xc4: not forced and the strike already started (+0xdc <= now): if no infinite entry queued and the record has 3 entries (+0xcc == 3) the recovery part is spliced in (2/3-entry special cases) and state = 3 (play out); else state 6 (idle); record reset (UnitAnimState_Reset) and StopMove. Called by TickState (target out of reach), TickCombatOrder (order failed) and Update (queued move while acting). Was misnamed FinishDying

name: CUnitServer::TickState
purpose: per tick after Think: clears +0x20/+0x21; state 5 with the target out of reach (TargetInRange false) -> CancelAction(0); frozen flag 0x1000000 -> +0x20 = 1; restores the saved anim queue +0x148/+0x15c when +0x144 (hit reaction over); by state: 0/1 weapon switch (owner +0x270 != +0x26c -> vt[25] SelectWeapon) then (state 0: re-plan via BeginMoveTo(+0x9c, +0xa4) when +0x146) TickMovement; 2/4: RestartIdleAnim when +0x160 != -1 (pending hit reaction); 3: queue empty -> state 6, callback +0x978, Think; 5: TickAction; +0x160 = -1

name: CUnitServer::IsOrderBeforeDeadline
purpose: (dt): false when the current order is an attack (kind 3) in state 2 and now + dt > the next-attack tick +0x184

name: CUnitServer::TargetInRange
purpose: is the current order still executable at the strike: kinds 4/10 true (unless flag 0x10000000 blocks spells); 3/5/6: the target (or the quick item's spell object) must be alive (vt[55] == 0; talk/use allowed on dead) and its predicted position vt[52](+0xe0) within sqrt(+0xe8) of the owner

name: CUnitServer::CompleteOrder
purpose: (hitLocation): at the action end tick: kind 3: FireAttack(target, hit +0x108); if the chosen part of the target is dead and equals +0x194 the order's part becomes 6 (any) and the order continues (next swing); 4/5: CastOrderSpell; 6: ExecuteInteraction; 10 (use a consumable): the quick item of slot orderParam with subtype 2: its +4 count ++, ClearQuickSlot, CWorldServer::SpawnConsumableUnit(item, owner) (the st.tr.130 / unhuma unit at the owner); kinds 4..6/10 clear the order and ClearQueuedOrder (-> stand)

name: CUnitServer::PushCurrentOrderToQueue
purpose: when nothing is queued: the current order goes back to the queue (used by ApplyPendingStance so the order resumes after the transition)

name: CUnitServer::ApplyPendingStance
purpose: when +0x170/+0x174 (wanted stance / combat mode) differ from +0x168/+0x16c: tests the new stance on the passability map (refused -> restore, message 0xd, 0); accepted: walking units are stopped (state 6), the transition animation (BuildTransitionAnim) is played via PlayOneShotAnim (state 3) unless attacking; current order pushed back to the queue when it is empty; returns 1 while a transition runs

name: CUnitServer::StanceAllowedHere
purpose: (stance): 3 counts as 2; true when unchanged; else the unit's cell must be passable for the move class of the new stance (temporarily applied)

name: CUnitServer::UpdateStanceFlags
purpose: +0x174 byte 0 (combat mode wanted) = 1 for an attack order (3), 0 for player units otherwise; +0x168 = owner stance (3 run -> 2 with +0x16d = 1), +0x170 = owner wanted (3 -> 2 with +0x175 = 1); +0x175 |= 2 when the order's run byte and standing; non-player units with combat mode: +0x175 |= 1

name: CUnitServer::ActivateQueuedOrder
purpose: copies the queued order +0x1b4..+0x1d4 into the current +0x190..+0x1b0 (target ref) and clears the queue; run byte with stance != 2: combat orders whose target is unreachable (big target >= 1.5 without a ranged weapon, or IsOrderTargetReachable false) force wanted stance 2; UpdateStanceFlags; +0x93c = tick

name: CUnitServer::ClearOrders
purpose: current order +0x190: kind = 9 (none), orderTarget +0x198 released, orderExact +0x1a8 / orderExtra +0x1ac / orderRun +0x1b0 = 0; when the queued order +0x1b4 is kind 9 too it is cleared as well (kind 0, target released, +0x1cc, +0x1d0..+0x1d4 = 0). No direct callers (inlined / dead)

name: CUnitServer::DispatchQueuedOrder
purpose: the order dispatcher (queued +0x1b4 -> current +0x190): nothing queued (kind 9) -> 0; sitting (stance 4) and not kind 11 -> stand up first (wanted stance 2, ApplyPendingStance); run byte +0x1d4 with stance != 2 and no reachable combat target -> wanted stance 2 (stand up); kind 0: stand (idle anim set, StopMove, state 2); 1: move (arrival pre-test |d|^2 < 0.02, CollectPartyFollowers, +0x43c = IsCellWater, BeginMoveTo(pos, z = max path length), ReportMoveResult when +0x1ac); 2: turn in place (CMover::ResetWithTarget, state 1); 3..6: ExecuteCombatOrder; 7: script animation +0x1ac via PlayOneShotAnim; 8: looping script animation via PlayLoopAnim; 10: consumable (BuildActionAnimQueue kind 6, action record +0xc4, StartAction); 11: sit (wanted stance 4; refused -> message 0x1b); +0x93c = order tick

name: World_GetTick
purpose: (world): world +0x64, the server tick

name: Order_Clear24
purpose: (order): kind 9, target released, +0x18/+0x1c/+0x20 = 0 (the full 0x24-byte order)

name: AnimQueue_CopyCtor
purpose: (this, src): vtable 0x73F01C; allocates count*12 (0x558AB0 init) and copies the entries, +0x14 = src+0x14

name: Order_Assign
purpose: (dst, src): operator= of the 0x24-byte Order: kind +0, param +4, target +8 (old ref released, new refcount ++), pos +0xc (3 floats), exact byte +0x18, extra +0x1c, run byte +0x20; CUnitServer::DispatchQueuedOrder copies the queued order +0x1b4 into the current one +0x190 with it

name: CUnitServer::Think
purpose: order step for states 0/1/2/6: DispatchQueuedOrder (returns if it started something, +0x938 = 0); UpdateStanceFlags; ApplyPendingStance (returns while a stance transition runs); current order 1/2 in state 6 -> finished: +0x18c = 1, player message 0xe when +0x145 (blocked) and no follow target, queued order cleared (-> kind 0 = stand); 3..6 -> TickCombatOrder; 7 -> clear; then DispatchQueuedOrder again

name: CUnitServer::GetMoveTargetPos
purpose: (out[3]): the position of the current order when its kind is 1 (move), else of the queued order when kind 1; returns 1 when found

name: CUnitServer::OrderIsOffensiveSpell
purpose: order kinds 4/5 whose spell proto index (+0x18 >> 16) < 9 (the elemental attacks) or == 0x1A antimagic

name: CUnitServer::GetAttackRange
purpose: the equipped weapon's range +0x58 or the natural range +0x250 (stats +0x70)

name: CUnitServer::GetAttackKind
purpose: weapon damage kind or the natural kind +0x28c (stats +0xac)

name: CUnitServer::HasRangedWeapon
purpose: true when the equipped weapon's kind is 5 or 6 (bows / throwing); 0 without a weapon

name: CUnitServer::IsRangedAttacker
purpose: no weapon: natural kind != 0x10 and natural range +0x250 > 1; weapon: kind 5/6

name: CUnitServer::AnimDurationFrames
purpose: (entry): round(entry+0x4c * 15 / +0x210) (0 without an entry)

name: CUnitServer::GetQuickItem
purpose: (id | 0x80000000): the CItemQuick (typeId 0x13, subtype 5/8) in weapon slot id & 0x7fffffff

name: CUnitServer::IsQuickItemId
purpose: (id): true when bit 31 is set and the slot holds a CItemQuick of subtype 5 / 8

name: CUnitServer::GetOrderItem
purpose: (id): inventory item (CUnit::GetItemSpell) or, for bit-31 ids, the quick item's spell +0x44

name: CUnitServer::CanCastSpell
purpose: (spell, checkSkill): player units with checkSkill: MagicSkill(proto +0x14 school) >= spell level +0x50; and !flag 0x10000000

name: CUnitServer::AttackAnimDuration
purpose: (kind, weapon): kind 3: round((weapon proto +0x6c or the natural default) * 15 / actionSpeed +0x210) ticks = the attack period

name: CUnitServer::GetDamage7
purpose: (out 7 shorts): displayed damage per type: heroes with a weapon: (weapon +0x50 + +0x54) * buffs * the 7 proto factors; else (stats +0x84 + +0x88) * buffs * natural factors +0x90

name: CUnitServer::GetSpellCostVector
purpose: (spell id, out 4 shorts): out[0] = 0x7fff, out[1 + element index (3/4/5)] = mana cost (UI)

name: CUnitServer::ComputeCastTarget
purpose: (CSpell*, caster, caster pos, target unit, target point) -> bool: only when the proto needs a trace (+0x40 Req.Trace): target point = unit pos + height (or terrain + 1), caster eye = pos + height; CAIMap::TraceVisibility (world +0x170) >= 0.1 passes

name: CUnitServer::PrepareCastParams
purpose: (order, out[6]): for 4/5 with a targeted spell proto (+0x40): unit target -> out[5] = target, out[3] = (radii + 0.3)^2, out[4] = own height; point -> out[0..2] = pos with terrain z + 1; other orders on a unit: out[3] = 10, out[5] = target

name: CUnitServer::CanAffordSpell
purpose: (order): inventory spell: player units need mana (placement +0x34) >= cost +0x40 * 25/int; quick items (bit 31 ids): subtype 5 needs charge +0x28 >= cost; 1 when castable

name: CUnitServer::OrderReachDistance
purpose: (order): 0.2 when order+0x18; kinds < 4 or 7+ on a unit: own radius +0x32c + target radius + max(weapon range +0x58 / natural +0x250, 0.6 (0.2 between party members)); on an object: weapon range + both radii vt[60]; kind 6: talk = own radius + 0.3 * target radius, unit = radii + 0.6, object = radii - 0.1; 4/5: the spell's range +0x34 (natural +0x250 for monsters with attack kind 0x10), 10 without a spell

name: CUnitServer::CanCastAt
purpose: (order, targetPos, tick): monsters refuse targets beyond max cast range (+0x2a4 / +0x904 * +0x294 * 1.05); spells refused with flag 0x10000000; line of sight for targeted spells (ComputeCastTarget)

name: CUnitServer::IsOrderTargetReachable
purpose: (order): temporarily sets flag 0x8000000 on the unit target, 0x54CA40(this, order, &temp path buffer) (path exists), clears it

name: CUnitServer::IsAggroTarget
purpose: (unit): a unit with flag 0x20000000 (set on death in multiplayer: a lootable corpse) is a target only while CWorldServer::HasLootRecordFor(unit id, owner id) is false; else true when a known neighbour (brain memory list) is alive and currently executing order kind 6 with param 0x18A95 (talk) on us in state 5 or with +0x18E set, i.e. someone talking to us

name: CUnitServer::CanReachTarget
purpose: (order): kinds 3/6 on a living unit with move class 0: ranged weapons always; melee only when the target's size (proto +0x24 + z) < 1.5 (big units cannot be meleed)

name: CUnitServer::CanReachOrderTarget
purpose: (order): like CanReachTarget (size < 1.5 test for melee on living units) then 0x54C6B0(this, order) (distance check)

name: CUnitServer::CanReachOrderTargetFrom
purpose: (order, pos[3]): the same check with the owner temporarily moved to pos

name: CUnitServer::PlanActionApproach
purpose: (order, out action record +0xc4): builds the action animation (ChooseAttackAnim kind 3 / BuildSpellAnimQueue 4,5 with cast time spell+0x4c*15/actionSpeed / BuildActionAnimQueue 6,10) to know its duration D; reach = OrderReachDistance (1e10 when order+0x18 exact); record +0x24 = reach^2 (moving unit target: (reach+0.5)^2 or (0.5*speed*(turnTicks/2+D)+reach+0.5)^2); over turnTicks = round(pi/turnRate)+3 ticks predicts the target (vt[52](tick)) and takes the first tick where it is within reach, facing within 0.01 rad (else waits one tick per rad) and CanCastAt; fills +0x20 target id, +0x18 start tick, +0x1c end tick = start + D, +0x14 anim start, the entries, +0x30 = (param != 6), +0x38 direction, spells: +0x28 = 1, +0x34 school (0x28 -> 1, 0x29 -> 0, else proto +0x14); 0 when no tick works

name: CUnitServer::ApproachTarget
purpose: chase step of combat orders (every tick while out of reach): uniform cost table (+0x43c = 1), predicts the target over the attack window, waits (state 2) when it will come into reach, else re-paths every 16 ticks to the interception point; BeginMoveTo(point, FollowDistance + 5) (see docs/game-exe/pathfinding.md 5.5)

name: CUnitServer::ExecuteCombatOrder
purpose: runs a combat/interaction order (kinds 3..6) once the target is in reach: weapon switch; PlanActionApproach(order, +0xc4) fails -> ApproachTarget (chase); talk on an aggro target -> drop; spells of kind-0x32 units in crawl -> wanted stance 1, other orders -> wanted stance 2 (net 6); ApplyPendingStance running -> +0x18e = 1; melee on a target of size >= 1.5 -> message 0xc, drop; attack before the next-attack tick +0x184 (+0xdc < +0x184) -> ApproachTarget; else +0x184 = max(+0x184, now + AttackAnimDuration (weapon proto +0x6c * 15 / actionSpeed +0x210)); spells: CanAffordSpell else messages 0xf / 0x11; kind 3 on a unit: BuildHitRecord(+0x108, backstab = IsBehindTarget unless target in combat mode or ranged weapon, hitLocation +0xf0, calledShot +0xf4) + target ResolveHitChance -> miss flag; StartAction(keepFacing, miss)

name: CUnitServer::TickCombatOrder
purpose: per Think for order kinds 3..6: player-known check (AiMemory::IsFriendOrKnown / CPlayerServer::IsIdKnown -> message 0x12 when unknown); spell orders need !flag 0x10000000; target dead (vt[55]) -> message 0xb (attack) / 0xe; +0x145 (blocked) -> message; otherwise ExecuteCombatOrder; failure: order cleared (kind 9), queue reset, CancelAction(0)

name: CUnitServer::FindInteractPoint
purpose: (order, out move state): kind 6 param 0: the target object's interaction points (vt[44]) tried with CAIMap::FindPath; the reachable one becomes the goal

name: CUnitServer::PredictInterceptTime
purpose: (order, move state): simulates the moving target's path on a scratch CMover in 5-tick steps and returns the tick our path meets it (sent in the move-state message)

name: MoveCurve::ResetSegment
purpose: (&segX0): zeroes the cached segment +0x50..+0x74 and sets segIndex +0xa0 = -1 (PredictInterceptTime's scratch curve before MoveCurve::Init). Was CUnitServer::ResetAIBlock28

name: CUnitServer::ValidateQueuedOrder
purpose: (order, msg): non-player units: always 1 (kind 6 excepted); player units: FindInteractPoint (fails -> SendMsg0E_MoveState kind 3 flag 1, 0); CanReachTarget and IsOrderTargetReachable -> SendMsg0E_MoveState(kind 3), player message msg (< 0x2a or 0x30, not -1), 1; else a scratch path (CAIMap::FindPath with the target removed from the collision map) to the target, reachability from its end, PredictInterceptTime; SendMsg0E_MoveState(path, kind 1/2) and NotifyPlayer(0xb attack / 0xe) on failure

name: CUnitServer::InitSubobject20
purpose: sets vtable 0x73EDB0 at +0x20 and zeroes fields, +0x38 = 0x80

name: CUnitServer::ReportMoveResult
purpose: (move state, found): ExportFullPath + CPlayerServer::SendMsg0E_MoveState to the owning player, message 1 (reached) / 0xe (blocked) (see pathfinding.md 5.4)

name: CUnitServer::UseConsumable
purpose: (no callers: the standalone copy of CompleteOrder kind 10): the quick item of slot orderParam with subtype 2 (consumable): +4 count ++, CUnit::ClearQuickSlot, CWorldServer::SpawnConsumableUnit(item, owner), then the item's vt[4] (release). Was UseQuickItem

name: CUnitServer::CastFromSlot
purpose: (slot id, target, pos): a weapon-slot item with charges +0x48: its spell (or the quick item's) is cast (CastSpellMulti) and one charge consumed (Unit_ConsumeItemCharge) (client messages 0x32/0x33)

name: CUnitServer::CastOrderSpell
purpose: at the action end of orders 4/5: spell = CUnit::GetItemSpell(+0x194) (inventory slot) or the weapon-slot quick item (id bit 31; subtype 5 charged / 8 scroll) +0x44; target point = target display pos or +0x19C; player units: mana +0x34 -= cost +0x40 * ManaCostFactor (25/int), clamped 0..max, net 0; quick items: ConsumeItemCharge(cost) (refused when charge +0x28 < cost); CWorldServer::CastSpellMulti(spell, owner, owner pos, target, point, 0); noise radius +0xFC * 2 kind 0x1A unless proto type +0x10 == 1 (sense school, silent); +0x194 = -1

name: CUnitServer::ExecuteInteraction
purpose: (target) at the action end of kind 6: talk (0x18A95): world dialog start + noise; param 0/1/2 = the attribute skills science / stealing / tame (log line ' is using skill <name> his_skill = .. target_skill = ..': own vs target AttrSkillWithWeapons(kind 0)); failure -> AggroTable_Add(owner, target) / OnProvoked; science on an item; stolen items moved to the player (CPlayer::AddItems 0x665470 / CUnit::PopRandomQuickItem, 'Item has been stolen from')

name: CUnitServer::FireAttack
purpose: (target, hit): melee: target->vt[31](hit, owner, owner) = CMapObject::TakeHit -> CUnitServer::TakeHit at once; ranged (kind 5/6): a CEffectArrowFigure (effect kind 0x5b) is launched from the owner's attach point with the 15-dword hit copied to +0x160, target id +0x150, shooter +0x15c (CEffectArrowFigure::Update applies target->vt[31] on arrival); TriggerWeaponSpell; a non-backstab (hit[13] == 1.0) makes noise: StimulusMap::HearSound(radius stats+0xfc * 2, kind 0x1a)

name: CUnitServer::BuildHitRecordFor
purpose: (target, hitLocation, calledShot): backstab = CUnit::IsBehindTarget unless the target unit is in combat mode (+0x174 byte 0) or the weapon is ranged (kind 5/6); BuildHitRecord(+0x108, backstab, location, calledShot)

name: CUnitServer::BuildHitRecord
purpose: (out hit[15], backstab, hitLocation, calledShot): heroes with a weapon in slot +0x26C: hit[0..6] = the weapon proto's 7 damage-type factors (+0x98..), hit[7] = weapon +0x4C, hit[8] = random even number in [-4, 2n-4] (unused: ResolveHitChance overwrites it), hit[9] = damage roll proto +0x50 + rand*+0x54; others: hit[0..6] = natural factors stats +0x90, hit[7] = 0, hit[8] = stats +0x74 attack skill * difficulty table 0x7C54AC[g_0x79BEC0] (1.0 for heroes), hit[9] = stats +0x84 + rand(0..+0x88); hit[9] *= strengthen/weaken buffs (0x1D/0x1E, 0.3 % per level); hit[10] = 1.0 armor factor, hit[11] = location, hit[12] = 0, hit[13] = 3.0 + backstab perk % for a backstab else 1.0, hit[14] byte = calledShot; player +0x108 > 1 (cheat) -> Hit_Init (infinite damage)

name: CUnitServer::TriggerWeaponSpell
purpose: (target): the equipped weapon's embedded spell (+0x44, flag bit 16, cost <= charge +0x28) is cast on the target after every attack (ConsumeItemCharge + CastSpellMulti)

name: CUnitServer::TriggerArmorSpells
purpose: (onHit): equipped items 0..6 with an embedded spell (flag bit 16, affordable): kind 0x18 spells only when onHit == 0 (on death), others only onHit (when hit): cast on self

name: CUnitServer::ChooseAttackAnim
purpose: (hit, queue, out duration, target): hit location: order param 6 = random from a 20-entry table (0 x2, 1 x6, 2 x3, 3 x3, 4 x3, 5 x3) else the param, resolved by UnitStats_PickHitLocation on the target; the strike height band from both units' heights (location 0 top 80 %, 1..3 40..80 %, 4/5 0..40 % of the target, random point, mapped onto the attacker's 0.4/0.8 height bands): flags 0x1000000 high / 0x2000000 middle / 0x3000000 low (| 0x800000); far targets (> 5 m) by slope +-60 deg; non-0x32 units: flag 0x2000000.. by reach ((+0x244+1)*radius); hit[11] = location; BuildActionAnimQueue(kind 3, flags)

name: CUnitServer::GetAttackKindMask
purpose: 1 << damage kind (weapon or natural when < 7): the animation set selector

name: CUnitServer::MoveModeAnimFlag
